department: Department of Computer Science (College of Connected Computing)

deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1, 2026 (also the fee-waiver deadline); final deadline December 15, 2026, and December 15 is also the completion date for fellowship consideration.
deadline.quote: Priority deadline for Fall 2027 Admission (Deadline for fee waiver) December 1 Final deadline for Fall 2027 Admission December 15

gre_general.value: The program has indefinitely waived GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Program for Computer Science has indefinitely waived GRE scores for consideration for admission.

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed before review, but applicants are encouraged to contact and list faculty they want to work with.
supervisor.quote: No. However, you are encouraged to reach out to and list any faculty in which you may want to work with that are in line with your research interest.

funding.value: PhD students receive a stipend, full tuition waiver and health insurance, through a teaching or research assistantship; continuation depends on progress.
funding.quote: Graduate students in the computer science department seeking the Ph.D. degree receive a competitive stipend, full tuition waiver and health insurance.

entry_route.value: Apply directly with or without a master's; a bachelor's holder can earn the master's on the way.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who are interested in earning a Ph.D., whether or not they have a master’s degree, are encouraged to apply directly to the Ph.D. program.

notes: Spring 2027 PhD deadline is October 15, 2026. The CS fee-waiver rule is portal-determined (U.S. schools and some non-U.S. institutions).
